title: Missing Number
description:
The array `nums` has length `n` and holds `n` **distinct** numbers taken from the range `[0, n]`. That range contains `n + 1` numbers, so exactly one of them is absent from `nums`.

Return the number from `[0, n]` that does not appear in `nums`.
constraints: All values in nums are distinct

examples.explanation: n = 4, so the range is [0, 4]. Every value except 2 is present.
n = 1, so the range is [0, 1]. Only 1 is present.
n = 3, so the range is [0, 3]. The missing value is n itself.
